title: A systematic study for predicting the performance of forward osmosis desalination using commercial low-cost superabsorber polymer (SAP) hydrogels as draw agents: water flux enhancement by tailoring process parameters
content:
Environ. Sci.: Water Res. Technol., 2025, 11,925-941
DOI: 10.1039/D4EW00918E, Paper
Waid Omar, Sarah Palloks, Huan Zhang, Michael Pollard, Florencia Saravia, Manfred Wilhelm
This study investigates the potential of using low-cost commercial superabsorbent polymers (SAPs) as draw agents in a hydrogel-driven forward osmosis (FO) desalination process.
